_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); analog semiconductor signals; the listing and short-history bounds rules (AVGO)

pit_profile.why: Broadcom: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor, or CMOS, based devices and analog III-V based products', 'We have four reportable segments: wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2017 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: the company's own FY2017 10-K says 'In addition, the shift to cloud-based IT solutions and services, such as hyperscale computing, may adversely affect both our wired infrastructure and enterprise storage segments.' At the same time it sells to cloud data-center providers as well: 'As cloud-based IT solutions become more prevalent, our results of operations will suffer if we are unable to increase sales of our products to cloud-based data center providers'. The stock trades at 58.4x FY18E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of its enterprise storage and networking specifically.

classification.quality_note: Broadcom: 'We are a leading designer, developer and global supplier of a broad range of semiconductor devices with a focus on complex digital and mixed signal complementary metal oxide semiconductor, or CMOS, based devices and analog III-V based products', 'We have four reportable segments: wired infrastructure, wireless communications, enterprise storage, and industrial & other, which align with our principal target markets', and 'We operate a primarily outsourced manufacturing business model' (its own FY2017 10-K); 'The global semiconductor market is highly competitive', and 'We operate in the highly cyclical semiconductor industry, which is subject to significant downturns': a cyclical and competitive risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; +290% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.19; conservative 2yr -55%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -2.7%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17 ex-FY09 ex-FY14 ex-FY16, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +21.7%/yr (Q1 FY18 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 8.3-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 median

BULL.desc: EPS +35.6%/yr (FY08-FY17 ex-FY09 ex-FY14 ex-FY16 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +155.0%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17 ex-FY09 ex-FY14 ex-FY16, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: AVGO (retrospective, 2018-02-09) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B infx (80.4% downside to Bear $46.22 / -18.8% upside to Bull $191.18) | Adj composite 2.46 vs market 2.65: gap -0.19 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +290% above the EPP floor $60.45 (15x FY18E $4.03) | Conservative 2-yr case: -54.6% total (-27.3%/yr) | At 58.4x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $311.45 sits above the BULL case; net revenue +17.1% YoY in Q4 FY17, forward revenues +28.1-29.3% (Q1 FY18 revenue guide (guidance update 8-K)); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
